correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration of 32,767 nonzero masks into 279 orbits under all 168 binary projective matrices; geometric smoothness iff each of three dehomogenized Jacobian ideals is the unit ideal over an algebraic closure. Exactly 78 smooth orbits totaling 10,920. Direct characteristic-two tangent-restriction coefficients identify contact orders 2/3/4; a second symbolic expansion reproduces all 78 representative profiles. The 34 weighted frequencies and sharp bounds follow from complete tables, not samples.

originality.rationale: The precise 34-cell F2 rational contact-order frequency, split into ordinary order-three and hyperflex order-four points and its 10,920-incidence identity, was absent from the material read in the full characteristic-two classification and the relevant inflection geometry works. Earlier 78-class and 10,920-equation enumerations were not claimed as new. This is a qualified self-review originality judgment, not proof that all unpublished numerical tables are absent.

value.rationale: Rational flex and hyperflex incidence is a motivated arithmetic refinement of the genus-three quartic moduli problem and of inflection-line geometry. This complete natural finite classification yields 34 possible joint profiles, sharp attained flex/hyperflex limits, and an exact incidence identity averaging one rational ordinary flex per smooth quartic equation. It is not an arbitrary slice or a reprint of known total class counts.
